description: Agent URL & SSRF Firewall API: Validate URLs and redirect chains against SSRF, private IPs, and cloud metadata targets. (Endpoint: POST /v1/ssrf-firewall)

check_dns.description: Resolve A/AAAA records via DoH and check resolved IPs (default true).

inspect_redirects.description: Follow redirects via private fetcher to inspect redirect chain (default false).

url.description: Target URL to evaluate for SSRF risk.

name: tinplate_ssrf_firewall
